title: Rumour: Heated Rivalry is filming two more seasons and planning a film
summary: Deadline reports that seasons two and three are being shot together. The broadcaster has not confirmed it.
body:
This is an unconfirmed report. The hit ice hockey romance Heated Rivalry is filming its second and third seasons back to back, with a Christmas film to follow, according to Deadline. The Canadian broadcaster Crave told Deadline it had "no projects to confirm".

According to the report, each new season will have six episodes, and filming on both is due to finish around the end of November.

A film for cinemas

Deadline says a separate holiday-themed film is planned for cinemas in December 2027.

Only the second season has been officially announced. The show's creator, Jacob Tierney, has said it will have six episodes, and it is expected in spring 2027.

Sources: Deadline, TVLine, The Playlist.
